shared_decisions.decision: objective surrogate for the sup-norm / max term
shared_decisions.everyone: smooth the max with a log-sum-exp (Dinkelbach/annealed beta) and/or a top-m mean, then optimize the smoothed ratio
alternatives: optimize the exact ratio R directly with a subgradient/active-set method on the true argmax knot (no smoothing)
use a hard-max epigraph formulation (hinge on L-t) solved as a sequence of LPs/QPs, never touching LSE

shared_decisions.everyone: L-BFGS-B (or Nelder-Mead/golden-section as a polish) on the full or masked height vector with analytic gradients
alternatives: projected/accelerated first-order methods (FISTA/Adam) with many cheap iterations instead of quasi-Newton
interior-point or trust-region Newton on a reduced active set with explicit Hessian-vector products

shared_decisions.everyone: a dense nonnegative height vector on a uniform grid, normalized to sum 1, refined by upsampling/resampling between resolutions
alternatives: parametric/low-dimensional form (Fourier envelope times lattice, spline control points) optimized in the small paramete…
sparse support + continuous knot positions (moving mesh / free boundaries) rather than fixed uniform cells

shared_decisions.everyone: coarse-to-fine ladder with interpolation/area-preserving resampling (or np.repeat) between grid sizes, re-polishing each level
alternatives: solve once at a single high resolution from a good analytic seed, no ladder
adaptive mesh refinement that only refines near the f*f peak and coarsens elsewhere

shared_decisions.everyone: random perturbations (Gaussian/low-mode Fourier kicks) plus restart of the same L-BFGS/LSE polish, accepted only if exact R improves
alternatives: population/genetic recombination with crossover as the primary search operator
deterministic basin-hopping with a learned/annealed proposal distribution or simulated annealing on R

shared_decisions.everyone: monotone: keep a candidate only if exact R strictly increases (greedy hill-climb)
alternatives: allow temporary R decreases (simulated annealing / tabu) to cross barriers
multi-objective/Pareto acceptance on (R, peak-width shares) to keep diverse near-optimal shapes

shared_decisions.decision: handling of the L1 normalization / scale
shared_decisions.everyone: fix sum(f)=1 by renormalizing inside every objective evaluation and work with the ratio directly
alternatives: optimize unnormalized f and let L1 float, penalizing it in the objective
parameterize f as a probability simplex (softmax/logit coordinates) so normalization is automatic

shared_decisions.everyone: a fixed hand-tuned fraction split (e.g. ~55% surrogate loop, rest transport+polish) with wall/process-time deadlines checked inside the objective
alternatives: adaptive budget that reallocates based on observed marginal gain per phase (bandit-style)
anytime schedule driven by a target R or plateau-detection rather than fixed time shares
